name: kopi-pagi
description: Turns one lecture PDF into a morning blog you can read with coffee: a student's own story first, then the theory explained the way a friend would explain it, closing with one question you can answer in two sentences. Four helpers split the work, check it against a written rulebook, and stop before publishing until you say yes.

displayDescription.en: Feed it today's lecture PDF and you get two things: a 500-word rangkuman sent to your own email, and a morning blog in casual Indonesian that goes live only after you approve it. Four roles check each other against a written rulebook.
displayDescription.zh: 给它一节课程的 PDF，换回两样东西：发到你邮箱的 500 字课程摘要，以及一篇只有你点头后才上线的晨间博客。四个角色按成文规则互相把关。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Write today's morning blog for me, full review pipeline. Answer in Indonesian.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写今天那节课的晨间博客，走完整审核流程。用印尼语回答。

quickPrompts.en: Write today's morning blog for me, full review pipeline. Answer in Indonesian.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写今天那节课的晨间博客，走完整审核流程。用印尼语回答。

quickPrompts.en: Show me the draft and the reviewer's findings before anything is published
quickPrompts.zh: 发布前先把草稿和审核结果给我看

quickPrompts.en: Run the test cases and save the results
quickPrompts.zh: 跑一遍测试用例并存下结果
